title: Ads

adviceLong.loss: Cut: already loses money before ads

noAdsets: No ad set in this period.

diagDo.scale: +20–30 % budget every 2–3 days, not more at once.
diagDo.cut: Cut this ad set: it spends without bringing enough profitable orders.
diagDo.hook: Change the first 3 seconds (question, problem, striking result).
diagDo.fatigue: Add 1–2 new videos to this ad set (new hook, new angle).
diagDo.audience: Duplicate with a wider audience or other wilayas.
diagDo.page: Check price, photos, reviews, delivery fees and the page form.
diagDo.wait: Let it run a few days before deciding.

diagNone: Nothing urgent: no ad set needs action.
diagRulesText: We compare the last 7 days with the 7 days before.
Cut: no purchase after 3 × the target cost per purchase ($25 without target), or the product loses money.
Audience exhausted: frequency ≥ 2.5 and CPM up 20 % or more, while hook and CTR hold.
Video fatigue: hook down 30 % or more, or CTR down 25 % or more, or frequency ≥ 2.2 with cost per purchase up 40 %.
Weak hook: fewer than 20 % of people watch 3 seconds.
The page does not convert: more than 100 page visits and fewer than 1.5 % buy (or fewer than 60 % of clicks reach the page).
Increase the budget: cost per purchase down 15 % or more (or profitable product), frequency below 2.2.
daysNote: Meta spend and orders received (Pilotix) each day
monthsNote: A closed month keeps its figures as they were (late returns no longer change them). Click a month to show it.

adsNote: Lifetime figures · "7 d" = cost per purchase over the last 7 days
